content.json:
# 📈 GitHub Repository Traffic - 1 Year Trends
---
Long-term **clones**, **views**, **referrers**, **popular content** and **stars / forks / watchers** for your GitHub repository, reconstructed from daily snapshots stored in Sentinel (`GitHubTraffic_CL`). GitHub itself only keeps 14 days of traffic, so this workbook only shows history accumulated since the daily snapshot job started running.

## What this workbook shows
- **KPIs** — total and unique clones and views for the selected period.
- **Clones / Views trend** — per-day line charts of traffic with unique cloners and visitors.
- **Weekly trends** — week-over-week clones and views as connected lines (best for spotting short-term progress).
- **Monthly aggregation & Monthly trends** — clones and views rolled up per month, as bars and as a trend line.
- **Yearly trends** — clones and views totals per year.
- **Detail table** — de-duplicated daily breakdown you can sort and export.
- **Referring sites** — top external sources sending traffic (30-day and 1-year views).
- **Popular content** — most viewed paths / pages in the repo (30-day and 1-year views).
- **Stars, forks & watchers** — current social engagement counts.

## How to use it
Use the **Time range** and **Repository** selectors at the top to scope every chart. Granularity increases as more history accumulates: weekly lines appear after ~2 weeks, monthly after ~2 months, yearly after the calendar rolls over.

> ℹ️ Duplicate per-day points (from overlapping 14-day snapshot windows) are de-duplicated at query time with `summarize max()` per day and metric. Referrers, popular content and social counts use the **latest** snapshot. Referrers and paths are rolling 14-day totals (GitHub exposes no per-day breakdown for them).

parameters.name: Repository
parameters.label: Repository
parameters.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| distinct RepoFullName
| sort by RepoFullName asc

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| summarize Count = max(Count), Uniques = max(Uniques) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), MetricType
| summarize
    ['Total clones'] = sumif(Count, MetricType == 'clones'),
    ['Unique cloners'] = sumif(Uniques, MetricType == 'clones'),
    ['Total views'] = sumif(Count, MetricType == 'views'),
    ['Unique visitors'] = sumif(Uniques, MetricType == 'views')
content.title: Totals for selected period

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| where MetricType == 'clones'
| summarize Clones = max(Count), ['Unique cloners'] = max(Uniques) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
| render timechart
content.title: Clones per day (with unique cloners)

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| where MetricType == 'views'
| summarize Views = max(Count), ['Unique visitors'] = max(Uniques) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
| render timechart
content.title: Views per day (with unique visitors)

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| summarize DailyCount = max(Count), DailyUniques = max(Uniques) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), MetricType
| summarize Total = sum(DailyCount), Uniques = sum(DailyUniques) by Month = startofmonth(Day), MetricType
| sort by Month asc, MetricType asc
content.title: Monthly totals (clones and views)

content.json:
## Weekly trends
Week-over-week progression of clones and views as connected lines. Weekly buckets (vs monthly) give enough points to draw a visible trend line even with a short history.

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| where MetricType == 'clones'
| summarize DailyCount = max(Count), DailyUniques = max(Uniques) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| summarize Clones = sum(DailyCount), ['Unique cloners'] = sum(DailyUniques) by Week = startofweek(Day)
| sort by Week asc
| render timechart
content.title: Clones per week

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| where MetricType == 'views'
| summarize DailyCount = max(Count), DailyUniques = max(Uniques) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| summarize Views = sum(DailyCount), ['Unique visitors'] = sum(DailyUniques) by Week = startofweek(Day)
| sort by Week asc
| render timechart
content.title: Views per week

content.json:
## Monthly trends
Month-over-month progression of clones and views as connected lines. A line appears once at least 2 months of history have accumulated.

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| where MetricType == 'clones'
| summarize DailyCount = max(Count), DailyUniques = max(Uniques) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| summarize Clones = sum(DailyCount), ['Unique cloners'] = sum(DailyUniques) by Month = startofmonth(Day)
| sort by Month asc
| render timechart
content.title: Clones per month

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| where MetricType == 'views'
| summarize DailyCount = max(Count), DailyUniques = max(Uniques) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| summarize Views = sum(DailyCount), ['Unique visitors'] = sum(DailyUniques) by Month = startofmonth(Day)
| sort by Month asc
| render timechart
content.title: Views per month

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| where MetricType in ('clones', 'views')
| summarize DailyCount = max(Count) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), MetricType
| summarize Total = sum(DailyCount) by Year = startofyear(Day), MetricType
| sort by Year asc, MetricType asc
content.title: Clones and views per year

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| summarize Count = max(Count), Uniques = max(Uniques) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), MetricType
| project Day, MetricType, Count, Uniques
| sort by Day desc, MetricType asc
content.title: Daily breakdown (de-duplicated)

content.json:
## Referring sites
GitHub only exposes a rolling 14-day total per referrer (no per-day breakdown), so each value is the peak 14-day total observed in the window. Left: last 30 days. Right: last year.

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| where MetricType == 'referrer'
| summarize Views = max(Count), ['Unique visitors'] = max(Uniques) by Site = Dimension
| sort by Views desc
content.title: Top referrers - last 30 days

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| where MetricType == 'referrer'
| summarize Views = max(Count), ['Unique visitors'] = max(Uniques) by Site = Dimension
| sort by Views desc
content.title: Top referrers - last year

content.json:
## Popular content
GitHub only exposes a rolling 14-day total per path (no per-day breakdown), so each value is the peak 14-day total observed in the window. Left: last 30 days. Right: last year.

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| where MetricType == 'path'
| summarize Views = max(Count), ['Unique visitors'] = max(Uniques), Title = take_any(Title) by Dimension
| project Content = iif(isempty(Title), Dimension, Title), Path = Dimension, Views, ['Unique visitors']
| sort by Views desc
content.title: Most viewed paths - last 30 days

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| where MetricType == 'path'
| summarize Views = max(Count), ['Unique visitors'] = max(Uniques), Title = take_any(Title) by Dimension
| project Content = iif(isempty(Title), Dimension, Title), Path = Dimension, Views, ['Unique visitors']
| sort by Views desc
content.title: Most viewed paths - last year

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| where MetricType in ('stars', 'forks', 'watchers')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Count) by MetricType
| summarize Stars = sumif(Count, MetricType == 'stars'), Forks = sumif(Count, MetricType == 'forks'), Watchers = sumif(Count, MetricType == 'watchers')
content.title: Current totals

content.query:
GitHubTraffic_CL
| where RepoFullName == '{Repository}'
| where MetricType in ('stars', 'forks', 'watchers')
| summarize Count = max(Count) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), MetricType
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
| render timechart
content.title: Stars / forks / watchers over time
